description: Western Province - Appointed Mr. Parape Arachchige Asiri Sandaruwan Weerasekara to assignthe duties as the Western Province Commissioner of the Co-operative Develoment and Registrar of the Co-operative Societies w.e.f. 26.01.2016
categorisation: This gazette content specifically names an individual (Mr. Parape Arachchige Asiri Sandaruwan Weerasekara) and announces his appointment to a specific government position (Western Province Commissioner of the Co-operative Development and Registrar of the Co-operative Societies). It does not include detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas that the individual will oversee, which would make it a Hybrid (Type 3). Since it focuses solely on a personnel appointment with basic title information, it qualifies as a People Gazette (Type 2).
